physical: Gravitational time dilation — A clock deeper in a gravitational well runs slower than one higher up; the effect depends on depth in the well, not on the clock's own mass. Formula: Δt = Δτ ÷ √(1 − 2 × G × M ÷ (r × c²))
reflected_formula: Expansion Dilation = Expansion ÷ √(1 − 2 × (a constant with no partner) × Movement ÷ (Vibrance × Current²))
reflected_sentence: In Vibrational Reality, Expansion Dilation deepens as Movement gathers and Vibrance tightens: the Vortex slows Expansion the more Movement it holds.
rule_reason: No cost caused by resistance and no separation made by distance is named; the depth effect is a relation of position in a field, not a cost, so it keeps its shape.
interpretation: The relation keeps its shape. Time reflects to Expansion, mass to Movement, radius to Vibrance, and c to Current. The constant has no partner. Deeper in the Vortex means more Expansion Dilation.
closing: The rule decided on its own: no resistance-cost, keeps shape. I treated depth in the well as a positional relation, not a cost; that is the only place one could argue, but the rule as written does not count it.
